term_months.notes: The row '3-4 שנים' carries the remark 'לא כולל תקופה של 4 שנים': it covers plans of 3 years up to, not including, 4. Recorded at 36 months, the row's shortest term. The plan's rows run from '2-3 שנים' (1.25) to '18 שנים' (2.5): 2-6 years 1.25, 5-10 years 1.5, 10-15 years 2.0, 15-18 years 2.25, 18 years 2.5.
